description: This file defines the HttpService class implementing HTTP request handling, session management, and request retries for expired tokens within a TypeScript project. It includes methods for GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, and internal session refresh logic.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: Implements HTTP request logic, session refresh, and request retries, managing internal state and callbacks.

methods.name: setCallbacks
methods.description: Sets callback functions for updating response metadata and refreshing session.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Resets internal session and callback references.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host URL for HTTP requests.

methods.name: runHttp
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request, handles token expiration, and retries if needed.

methods.name: refreshSession
methods.description: Refreshes the session token by making a refresh request.

methods.name: createRequestBody
methods.description: Creates the request body based on HTTP method and parameters.

methods.name: createXmlRequest
methods.description: Creates and configures an XMLHttpRequest object.

methods.name: runRequest
methods.description: Sends the XMLHttpRequest and returns a promise with the response.

methods.name: stateChangeHandlerForRequest
methods.description: Handles XMLHttpRequest state changes and processes the response.
